g.text: Production Defect Intelligence Platform • Bayesian Risk Surveillance • pgvector RAG Citations • Sub-50ms Live Polling
Loads raw customer reviews via CSV & DB adapters (Amazon, CPSC, Support Tickets), normalizes to unified schema, SHA-256 dedupe.
2. Multi-Layer Defect Signal Detection & Spike Engine
Regex clustering on safety terms (overheating, shock, fire) + Bayesian severity weighting + 14-day defect spike detection ($k \ge 2.0x$).
3. Prioritized Risk Queue & Lead Time Prediction
Scores hazard probability (0–100), tracks review velocity, and flags critical items ~4–12 weeks prior to formal regulatory recall.
4. RAG Copilot with Grounded Review ID Citations
NVIDIA NIM LLM generates root-cause explanations grounded exclusively in retrieved reviews with mandatory review ID citations; refuses hallucinations.
Fires alerts automatically on threshold breach or velocity spike via Resend transactional email and Slack incoming webhooks with fail-soft isolation.
Shared useLiveData hook polls composite change token every 4.5s; updates Overview, Risk Queue, and Sidebar badge within ~4s without page reload.
Preserves scroll position, active filters, page selection, and modal inputs.
1. Sub-50ms API Latency & In-Memory Change Cache
/system/changes resolves in <1ms from in-memory cache (2.0s TTL), bypassing DB connection overhead on cache hits; indexed count/max only.
Strict 5-second timeout on all outbound network calls (Resend, Slack, LLM). Failures fail soft without crashing pipelines or database transactions.
Backtesting and lead-time simulations strictly mask all reviews after the simulation date, preventing future data leakage into historical scoring.
Single polling loop per browser tab; consumes only 230 bytes per poll (~3.0 KB/min). Pauses immediately when tab is hidden (Page Visibility API).
On consecutive server errors, polling interval backs off gracefully (4.5s -> 8s -> 14.5s -> 26s -> 30s max); header displays 'Reconnecting…'.
Zero committed API keys/secrets; environment-driven credentials; append-only audit_log table records all rule modifications, exports, and alerts.
Database connection strings and CORS strictly guarded.
